purpose: Teach: 異端/卑怯/束縛/醜い/人為/援護/邪悪/監獄

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者を異端者として扱わないよう警察、注意されてますね
lines.en: I understand the police are being careful not to treat the suspect as an outcast in this case.
lines.style: Measured, observational tone. Slight pause before speaking, as if turning the thought over. Intellectual curiosity without judgment. Steady eye contact, not rushed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、卑怯な詐欺の手口を捜査します
lines.en: We're investigating the deceptive fraud scheme thoroughly.
lines.style: Official but direct. Clear authority in the voice. Each phrase lands with quiet competence. No defensiveness—just stating what the work entails. Professional distance maintained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者を束縛していた状況を警察、確認されましたね
lines.en: I gather the police have confirmed that the victim was being controlled in this situation.
lines.style: Careful framing, as if laying out evidence piece by piece. Quiet gravity underneath the formal phrasing. Slight hesitation before the difficult word—acknowledging the weight of what's being said.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、醜い暴行事件を厳しく取り締まります
lines.en: We're pursuing this assault case with full severity.
lines.style: Firm resolve. Slight hardening in the tone at the word 'assault'—a boundary being drawn. Professional, not angry. The voice of someone who has seen harm and won't minimize it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、人為的な火災の疑いを警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: I understand the police are investigating the possibility of arson in this case.
lines.style: Slower tempo, weighing each word. The gravity of potential arson sits in the pause. Ren's tendency to intellectualize a serious matter, but with authentic concern underneath. Not detached.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者ご家族を援護する体制を整えます
lines.en: We're preparing support systems for the victim's family.
lines.style: Warmer than before—still official, but the human part showing. Voice steadies on the commitment. Not a promise to solve it, but a promise to stand with them. Shoulder-forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、邪悪な意図を持つ犯人を警察、追ってますね
lines.en: So the police are pursuing the suspect with malicious intent behind this case.
lines.style: Slight discomfort in phrasing—Ren catching himself, aware this is darker than his usual register. Intellectual framework struggling with the ugliness of what he's observing. Not quite meeting the eye.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、監獄からの脱走事案にも備えております
lines.en: We're also prepared for the possibility of a prison escape.
lines.style: Final checkpoint tone. Professional closure. No drama, just thoroughness. The voice of someone making sure every door is locked. Calm, competent, leaving no opening.
